dogecoin.text: Bitcoin hits an all-time high, and Texas is ready to back it with a Bitcoin reserve bill, only a signature away from reality. As Dow dives 600 points, Saylor says buying BTC now still makes sense. In other news, why did Dogecoin pump 8% on Wednesday? Let's discuss!

2024's surprises keep rolling: As Musk and Trump’s feud heats up, Dogecoin stumbles while viral memecoin Kori catches fire. Meanwhile, Dow Jones soars by 443 points thanks to stellar labor data. In crypto, Gemini eyes IPO, and IOST secures massive funding boost. Stay tuned!

Breaking Crypto Wave: NFTs are back with triple the buyers, while ETH ETFs show $59m outflows! Meanwhile, Gemini's IPO gamble heats up as Grayscale tempts Wall Street with GDOG, signaling a spot Dogecoin ETF possibly on the horizon. Fuel for your crypto FOMO!

Grayscale's bold move with GDOG: Wall Street eyes a spot Dogecoin ETF as ETH cools off! Amid this frenzy, NFTs bounce back stronger than ever, tripling their buyers, while Gemini's IPO bet raises eyebrows. Are we on the brink of another explosive crypto wave?
